chrome_hint: eBay AU sold: 'cast iron cobblers last' and 'cobbler shoe anvil tripod' (Sold items, last 90 days, Australia, note multi-lot and postage). Terapeak same terms. Also Facebook Marketplace/Gumtree asking for 'cobblers last' for retail asking range, and LiveAuctioneers/Invaluable only if a maker mark turns up.
viewing_check: Look for maker names or sizes cast into the bases or stems (e.g. Peter Wright, Fletcher), and check for cracks or breaks in the stems. Unmarked, sound lasts are low value.
